labels.label: defi:causal_Ealpha

hypotheses.paper: BTZ_1 prop:isom (BTZ_1.tex:378): alpha, beta in R_+, alpha != 2 pi
hypotheses.note: E_0 is Causal.Port.BPrimeE0 (alpha = beta = 0); the mixed pairs E_0 <-> E_kappa are not here (T-ett-e-models-bprime). At kappa = 2 pi there is no singular point (Sing(E_2pi) = empty); chartIso_of_isAEChart covers it through EAlphaGX.chartIso_of_isAEChart_two_pi

hypotheses.paper: BTZ_1 prop:isom: U open connected containing a singular point, phi : U -> E_beta a local homeomorphism
hypotheses.note: psi is an open partial homeomorphism (injective on its source), as IsAEChart asks; the conclusion is the local form, on a ball about each singular point of the source (prop_isom_local). The global form on a connected U (lem:liouville, BTZ_1.tex:360) and the case of a non-injective local homeomorphism are not proved. (b') needs only the local form

hypotheses.paper: BTZ_1 prop:isom: phi an almost everywhere E-morphism
hypotheses.note: DEC-25's reading: IsAEChart for EAlphaGX.singularGX, a.e. (G,X) both ways (gx's notion by isAEChart_iff_isAEMorphism)

hypotheses.paper: BTZ_1 prop:isom: conclusion 'phi is the restriction of an element of Isom(E_alpha)'
hypotheses.note: on a ball: psi (t, polar(r, theta)) = (t + s, polar(r, theta + c)) for every polar representation with r >= 0 (every point has one, exists_polar); same model: psi = rotShift s c (exists_eqOn_rotShift). Conversely every rotShift s c is an IsAEChart (isAEChart_rotShift)

hypotheses.paper: Isom(E^{1,2}) (ETT.tex:1331; BTZ_1.tex:459 'elliptic isometry of axis Delta')
hypotheses.note: OQ-82: Flat.isom 2 = SO_0(1,2) x| R^3. Used once, through the determinant, in isom_of_timeAxis (orthochronicity gives the time direction, the determinant excludes the reflections in timelike planes through the axis). Under O^+(1,2) x| R^3 the reflection conjE would be an a.e. isomorphism; it is a ChartIso (chartIso_conjE); the theorem for that group is not stated

hypotheses.paper: 'isomorphisms of the model spaces' in step (B) of prop:GX_sing_espace_temps_topo (ETT.tex:631-632)
hypotheses.note: OQ-64: (b') as in Causal.GXSingularDEC25, every IsAEChart between open subsets of the models is a ChartIso (chartIso_of_isAEChart; hiso_family)

hypotheses.paper: 'On any E_{>=0}-manifold M there is then a unique causal structure inducing that of E_alpha in every chart' (ETT.tex:1339-1340)
hypotheses.note: existsUnique_causality_ealpha: for E_{>0}-manifolds only (every singular point in an IsAEChart into some E_kappa, kappa > 0; no BTZ point), DEC-25's reading of the charts (maximal a.e. atlas plus every IsAEChart into a model), uniqueness among absolutely minimal causalities (OQ-18). No model hypothesis is left
[Fact (0 < kappa)]; no case split on kappa in 2 pi Z anywhere

findings: BTZ_1.tex:378-383 (prop:isom of brunswic2021cauchy, the author's source for the models), case alpha, beta > 0: confirmed in local form, with every step of the proof l.444-465 checked in Lean. Causal.BPrimeEAlpha.prop_isom_local: for kappa != 2 pi and an a.e. isomorphism chart psi : E_kappa -> E_kappa' whose source meets the singular line, kappa' = kappa and near the line psi (t, polar(r, theta)) = (t + s, polar(r, theta + c)). The steps: l.457 'g Delta = Delta' (smul_timeAxis, by limits along r -> 0); l.459 'g is an elliptic isometry of axis Delta with translation part in the direction of Delta' (isom_of_timeAxis); l.461 the 2k pi ambiguity of the developing map (the second connectedness step of exists_slitBox); l.462 'alpha must be an integral multiple of beta' (continuity across the slit) and 'alpha = beta' (local injectivity), both in eq_of_isAEChart.

BTZ_1.tex:459, one addition, the same as at alpha = 0 (T-ett-bprime-e0): 'Since the direction of Delta is timelike, g is an elliptic isometry of axis Delta' holds in SO_0(1,2) x| R^3, and needs the determinant. In O^+(1,2) x| R^3 the reflections in the timelike planes through Delta also preserve Delta and are not elliptic. At E_kappa the reflection theta -> -theta (Causal.BPrimeEAlpha.conjE) is a chart isomorphism (chartIso_conjE), and under SO_0(1,2) x| R^3 it is not an a.e. isomorphism chart (not_isAEChart_conjE). So OQ-82's answer changes the class of a.e. isomorphisms of E_kappa, as at E_0; as far as the reflections go it does not change (b').

ETT.tex:1339-1340, the (G,X) sentence of defi:causal_Ealpha: for E_{>0}-manifolds (no BTZ point) it holds in DEC-25's reading, with uniqueness among absolutely minimal causalities: Causal.BPrimeEAlpha.existsUnique_causality_ealpha, which is existsUnique_causality_singularGX_dec25 at the family {kappa // 0 < kappa} with every model hypothesis discharged. Its hypothesis (b') at the models is not an extra assumption: it is BTZ_1's prop:isom (hiso_family; chartIso_of_isAEChart). ETT.tex:1322-1323 promises 'the precise reference for each' model fact. The paper may want to cite brunswic2021cauchy prop:isom for (b') at the models E_alpha, alpha > 0, at l.1339-1341, at step (B) of prop:GX_sing_espace_temps_topo (l.631-632), or in the proof of cor:massA_causalite (l.1399-1406), as already found at E_0.

Roadmap, not the paper. The planner's [r] (block evidence, route (A)(iii)): 'Then psi(t, polar(r, theta)) = (t + s, polar(r, theta + phi)) on the slit box', with phi the rotation angle of g = (time translation) o rotIsom phi. This is incomplete. g fixes phi only modulo 2 pi, but the point polar(r, theta + phi) of E_kappa' depends on theta + phi modulo kappa'. The offset is c = phi + 2 pi m_0 (mod kappa'), for an integer m_0 read off the angle in E_kappa''s sector charts, which is continuous (chartAngle, continuousOn_chartAngle). One c on the whole slit box needs a second preconnectedness argument (exists_slitBox, through exists_forall_of_isPreconnected). This is BTZ_1's 'theta + 2k pi' (l.461). With c in place of phi, the rest of the planner's route is correct as written: continuity across the slit and injectivity at the angles -kappa'/2 and kappa'/2.

Roadmap, not the paper. The planner's [r] (A)(ii): 'HolRel reads psi into the disc charts of E_kappa' up to rotIsom (n kappa')'. This holds only for disc charts normalized by a real representative phi' of their centre direction, i.e. rotIsom phi' * chart k' with phi' = k'.theta in R/kappa'Z (chart_dev). Two unnormalized disc charts differ by an arbitrary rotation on their overlap (exists_rotation), not by a power of rotIsom kappa'. The normalization is part of HolRel, and HolRel.unique gets the n kappa' from polar_inj.

Roadmap, not the paper. The planner's [r] (i), 'for kappa = 2 pi n, n >= 2 ... the slit-box scheme loses nothing', is confirmed. No step splits on kappa in 2 pi Z. At kappa' in 2 pi Z the holonomy rotIsom kappa' is the identity, and HolRel.unique gives uniqueness outright. kappa = 2 pi itself is the only special case, because there the line is regular (Sing(E_2pi) = empty).
questions: OQ-82: which group is Isom(E^{1,2}) (ETT.tex:1331)? Reading taken: Flat.isom 2 = SO_0(1,2) x| R^3, the reading of record. It is used once, through the determinant (isom_of_timeAxis). Under O^+(1,2) x| R^3 the reflections theta -> c - theta of E_kappa would be a.e. isomorphisms and the statements would have to be restated for that group; the reflection is a ChartIso anyway (chartIso_conjE). Not ruled.

OQ-64: what is an 'isomorphism of the model spaces' (ETT.tex:631-632)? Reading taken: an a.e. isomorphism chart between open subsets of the models (IsAEChart for EAlphaGX.singularGX), and 'isomorphism of topological spacetimes' as ChartIso, as in Causal.GXSingularDEC25 and Causal.Port.BPrimeE0. Not ruled.

OQ-18: 'unique causal structure' (ETT.tex:1339). Reading taken in existsUnique_causality_ealpha: unique among absolutely minimal causalities for which some chart is an isomorphism at each point, as in existsUnique_causality_singularGX_dec25. Not ruled.
No new reading is introduced, and no new OQ row is proposed.

kb_proposals: (b') at E_kappa, kappa > 0, is Causal.BPrimeEAlpha.chartIso_of_isAEChart: every IsAEChart E_kappa -> E_kappa' (EAlphaGX.singularGX) is a ChartIso of massive kappa into massive kappa', its source meeting the line or not. Family form hiso_family (the hiso of existsUnique_causality_singularGX_dec25 over {kappa // 0 < kappa}); E_{>0}-manifolds existsUnique_causality_ealpha. The local form of BTZ_1's prop:isom is prop_isom_local (kappa' = kappa: eq_of_isAEChart), same model exists_eqOn_rotShift, converse isAEChart_rotShift (T-ett-bprime-ealpha).

The slit box at a timelike axis in parameter space: work with b = (t, r, theta) in R^3 and pt b = (t, polar(r, theta)) rather than an angle function on E_kappa. A sector chart normalized by a real representative phi of its centre, rotIsom phi * chart k with phi = k.theta, is the development (t, r e^{i theta}) (Causal.BPrimeEAlpha.chart_dev); near b the chart centred at pt b normalized by theta_b matches the parameters (eventually_chart_ringIndex_pt). Then HolRel and exists_holRel as in BPrimeE0 (T-ett-bprime-ealpha).

A development into E^{1,2} fixes the angle of a point of E_kappa' only modulo 2 pi, while the point needs it modulo kappa'. Recover it from the angle read in the target sector charts (Causal.BPrimeEAlpha.chartAngle, continuous on the chart source), and conclude with exists_forall_of_isPreconnected: a choice that is locally determined and pointwise unique is global on a preconnected set (T-ett-bprime-ealpha).

The stabiliser of the time axis in Flat.isom 2 is Causal.BPrimeEAlpha.isom_of_timeAxis: g (t, x) = (t + s, planeRot phi x). The determinant goes through LinearMap.det_prodMap. The spatial part goes to C through Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr, where linear_isometry_complex, det_rotation and Complex.det_conjAe exclude the reflection (T-ett-bprime-ealpha).

A translation of time times any isometry of space is a ChartIso of static spacetimes: Causal.BPrimeEAlpha.chartIso_shiftIso, through staticLe_map_shift / staticLt_map_shift. The rotations and the reflection of the cone C_kappa are ConeRot.rotIso and ConeRot.conjIso, by SeparationQuotient.lift on polar coordinates. Hoist candidates (T-ett-bprime-ealpha).

From EAlphaContinuation the file uses devPt, ringIndex, polar_inj, rad_polar, polar_eq_fromPlane, planeRot_apply', rotIsom_smul_repr, rotIsom_add, rotIsom_zero and rotIsom_eq_of_exp_eq. Every rotShift s c is an IsAEChart whose source meets the line, and a ChartIso; E_pi has Sing nonempty and satisfies the hypothesis of existsUnique_causality_ealpha (its singular points lie in the IsAEChart refl into the model E_pi). Graduation remarks: eq_of_eventuallyEq_of_continuousAt duplicates Causal.BPrimeE0.eq_of_eventuallyEq_of_continuousAt, in another namespace; a module opening both namespaces would be ambiguous. The generic helpers (exists_forall_of_isPreconnected, staticLe_map_shift, staticLt_map_shift, shiftIso, chartIso_shiftIso, ConeRot.*) may be hoisted. existsUnique_causality_ealpha goes beyond the models, as BPrimeE0's existsUnique_causality_e0 did: it is the E_{>0} half of the label's (G,X) sentence, stated over generic singular (G,X)-manifolds, not over MassAModel. Row partial, no mark: the label is about every E_{>=0}-manifold (kb 0006) and waits on OQ-34/OQ-35, OQ-82, OQ-64 and OQ-18.
